```{r setup, eval = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
source("constants.R")
source("loadToMySqlConfiguration.R")

install_if_missing("RMySQL")
```

```{r connectMySQL, eval = TRUE}
mysql_con <- dbConnect(
  RMySQL::MySQL(),
  host     = etl.mysql.host,
  port     = etl.mysql.port,
  user     = etl.mysql.user,
  password = etl.mysql.password,
  dbname   = etl.mysql.dbname
)
cat("Connected to MySQL.\n")
```

# 1. Data Warehouse Overview

The current document presents the cost analysis datamart created for Heracletes Advisors PC. The datamart features a star schema consisting of a central fact table called `expense_facts` along with dimensional tables for dates, employees, clients, projects, categories, currencies, and merchants.

```{sql overviewCounts, connection = mysql_con}
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expense_facts) AS total_facts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_employee)  AS total_employees,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_client)    AS total_clients,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_project)   AS total_projects,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_category)  AS total_categories
```

# 2. Total and Average Expense per Category per Quarter

This query tests the slicing capability of the fact table based on categories, which are aggregated quarterly.

```{sql expenseByCategory, connection = mysql_con}
SELECT dc.category_name,
       ef.year,
       ef.quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(ef.allocated_amount), 2) AS total_expense,
       ROUND(AVG(ef.allocated_amount), 2) AS avg_expense,
       COUNT(*) AS num_transactions
  FROM expense_facts ef
  JOIN dim_category dc ON ef.category_key = dc.category_key
 GROUP BY dc.category_name, ef.year, ef.quarter
 ORDER BY ef.year, ef.quarter, total_expense DESC
```

# 3. Total Expenses per Client per Project per Month

This highlights the essential analytical query, where we slice based on clients, projects, and time periods.

```{sql expenseByClientProject, connection = mysql_con}
SELECT dcl.client_name,
       dp.project_name,
       ef.year,
       ef.month,
       ROUND(SUM(ef.allocated_amount), 2) AS total_expense,
       ROUND(AVG(ef.allocated_amount), 2) AS avg_expense,
       COUNT(*) AS num_transactions
  FROM expense_facts ef
  JOIN dim_client  dcl ON ef.client_key  = dcl.client_key
  JOIN dim_project dp  ON ef.project_key = dp.project_key
 WHERE ef.client_key > 0
 GROUP BY dcl.client_name, dp.project_name, ef.year, ef.month
 ORDER BY dcl.client_name, dp.project_name, ef.year, ef.month
 LIMIT 20
```

# 4. Monthly Expense Trend

```{sql monthlyTrend, connection = mysql_con}
SELECT ef.year,
       ef.month,
       dd.month_name,
       ROUND(SUM(ef.allocated_amount), 2) AS total_expense,
       ROUND(AVG(ef.allocated_amount), 2) AS avg_expense,
       COUNT(*) AS num_transactions
  FROM expense_facts ef
  JOIN dim_date dd ON ef.date_key = dd.date_key
 GROUP BY ef.year, ef.month, dd.month_name
 ORDER BY ef.year, ef.month
```

# 5. Billable vs Non-Billable Expenses by Client

```{sql billableAnalysis, connection = mysql_con}
SELECT dcl.client_name,
       CASE WHEN ef.billable = 1 THEN 'Billable' ELSE 'Non-Billable' END AS expense_type,
       ROUND(SUM(ef.allocated_amount), 2) AS total_expense,
       COUNT(*) AS num_transactions
  FROM expense_facts ef
  JOIN dim_client dcl ON ef.client_key = dcl.client_key
 WHERE ef.client_key > 0
 GROUP BY dcl.client_name, ef.billable
 ORDER BY dcl.client_name, ef.billable DESC
```

# 6. Top 10 Expense Categories by Total Amount

```{sql topCategories, connection = mysql_con}
SELECT dc.category_name,
       dc.subcategory_name,
       ROUND(SUM(ef.allocated_amount), 2) AS total_expense,
       COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
       ROUND(AVG(ef.allocated_amount), 2) AS avg_per_txn
  FROM expense_facts ef
  JOIN dim_category dc ON ef.category_key = dc.category_key
 GROUP BY dc.category_name, dc.subcategory_name
 ORDER BY total_expense
 LIMIT 10
```

# 7. Expense per Employee per Quarter

```{sql employeeExpenses, connection = mysql_con}
SELECT CONCAT(de.first_name, ' ', de.last_name) AS employee_name,
       ef.year,
       ef.quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(ef.allocated_amount), 2) AS total_expense,
       COUNT(*) AS num_transactions
  FROM expense_facts ef
  JOIN dim_employee de ON ef.employee_key = de.employee_key
 GROUP BY de.employee_key, de.first_name, de.last_name, ef.year, ef.quarter
 ORDER BY de.last_name, ef.year, ef.quarter
 LIMIT 20
```

# 8. Currency Distribution

```{sql currencyDistribution, connection = mysql_con}
SELECT dcu.currency_code,
       COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
       ROUND(SUM(ef.txn_amount), 2) AS total_raw_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(ef.txn_amount), 2) AS avg_raw_amount
  FROM expense_facts ef
  JOIN dim_currency dcu ON ef.currency_key = dcu.currency_key
 GROUP BY dcu.currency_code
 ORDER BY num_transactions DESC
```

# 9. Quarterly Expense by Client (Year-over-Year View)

```{sql quarterlyByClient, connection = mysql_con}
SELECT dcl.client_name,
       ef.year,
       ef.quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(ef.allocated_amount), 2) AS total_expense,
       ROUND(AVG(ef.allocated_amount), 2) AS avg_expense
  FROM expense_facts ef
  JOIN dim_client dcl ON ef.client_key = dcl.client_key
 WHERE ef.client_key > 0
 GROUP BY dcl.client_name, ef.year, ef.quarter
 ORDER BY dcl.client_name, ef.year, ef.quarter
```

# 10. Partition and Index Verification

Ensure that partitioning and indexing are enabled on the fact table.

```{sql showPartitions, connection = mysql_con}
SELECT PARTITION_NAME, TABLE_ROWS
  FROM information_schema.PARTITIONS
 WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'expense_facts'
   AND TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
```

```{sql showIndexes, connection = mysql_con}
SHOW INDEX FROM expense_facts
```

